title.ko: 시제 일치 · 보고 동사 · 간접화법에서의 변화
title.en: backshift · reporting verbs · changes in reported speech

explain.ko: 간접화법에서는 전달 시점에 맞춰 시제를 한 단계 앞으로 이동시키고(backshift) 대명사와 시간·장소 표현을 바꿉니다. is → was, will → would, has done → had done, now → then, tomorrow → the next day, here → there. 단, 지금도 사실인 내용이나 보고 동사가 현재형일 때는 시제를 바꾸지 않아도 됩니다. say와 tell 외에 insist(that), suggest(-ing), admit(-ing), deny(-ing), warn(+목적어+to), promise(to), complain(that) 등 동사에 따라 뒤의 형태가 다릅니다. 동사 선택이 말의 의도까지 전합니다.
explain.en: In reported speech, shift tenses back by one step (backshift) and change pronouns, time and place words: is → was, will → would, has done → had done, now → then, tomorrow → the next day, here → there. You may keep the tense if the statement is still true or the reporting verb is in the present. Each reporting verb has its own pattern: insist (that), suggest (-ing), admit (-ing), deny (-ing), warn (+ object + to), promise (to), complain (that). The verb you choose also conveys the speaker's intention.

prompt.ko: 친구에게 들은 이야기를 간접화법과 다양한 전달 동사를 써서 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences retelling what a friend said, using reported speech and varied reporting verbs.

task.model: My friend said last week that he had had a hard time at his new job. He complained that his boss gave him too much work. I advised him to talk to his boss. He promised to do so the following week.

model_trans.ko: 친구는 지난주에 새 직장에서 힘들었다고 말했어요. 그는 상사가 너무 많은 일을 시킨다고 불평했어요. 저는 그에게 상사와 이야기해 보라고 조언했어요. 그는 다음 주에 그렇게 하겠다고 약속했어요.
model_trans.en: My friend said last week that he had had a hard time at his new job. He complained that his boss gave him too much work. I advised him to talk to his boss. He promised to do so the following week.
